## Description

Please describe the motivation, changes made, and context for this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Benchmark / performance optimization

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and formatting guidelines of this project (`ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`make ci`)
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / OpenAPI spec where appropriate
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or credentials have been committed
